name: 00-prechange-custom150
note: Windows Custom scaling visibly shows 150 before changing the disposable guest to 200.

name: 01-custom200-pending-signout
note: Windows confirms custom scale 200 is configured and requires sign-out; not yet evidence of applied DPI.

name: 02-resolution-1366x768
note: Windows Display shows 1366 x 768. Normal scale dropdown disabled because custom scaling is active; its 125% is not the custom value.

name: 03-custom200-applied
note: After user sign-in, Windows Custom scaling is 200 with no pending sign-out notice. Resolution captured separately as1366x768.

name: 04-startup-grid-focus-200
note: Clicking first visible row scrolls parent to show header and two full rows at200%/1366x768.

name: 05-startup-down-reveals-onedrive
note: Second Down moves focus to OneDrive, parent scroll follows and whole selected row visible.

name: 06-startup-ctrlend-200
note: Ctrl+End reveals final row and rightmost columns; selected row fully visible.

name: 07-startup-ctrlhome-200
note: Ctrl+Home reveals first selected row and leftmost column.

name: 08-startup-pagedown-200
note: PageDown reveals selected SecurityHealth row at bottom of grid.

name: 09-startup-end-200
note: End reveals rightmost selected-row cell. PageUp previously returned first row.

name: 10-startup-manual-scroll-hides-grid
note: Manually scrolling parent upward hides focused grid before keyboard navigation.

name: 11-startup-down-recovers-focus
note: Down after manual parent scroll restores selected second row fully into view.

name: 12-startup-shifttab-folder-200
note: Shift+Tab reveals full Open file location button with visible focus border.

name: 13-startup-readonly-tab-skip
note: Shift+Tab from folder skips disabled mutation buttons for all-users selected entry and focuses Refresh fully visible.

name: 14-startup-refresh-x3-200
note: Three consecutive Enter activations on focused Refresh returned without visible exception. No data mutation used yet to prove reload.

name: 15-startup-reverse-tab-cell-200
note: Shift+Tab from first cell moves to previous row last cell and reveals it horizontally and vertically; visible dotted focus.

name: 16-current-user-action-visible
note: Current-user OneDrive selection preserves enabled Disable selected action when parent scrolled upward. No modification performed.

name: 17-startup-return-refresh-200
note: Startup to Storage to Startup, then Refresh returned populated grid without visible exception.

name: 18-checkup-ctrlend-200
note: Checkup Ctrl+End reveals final Apps result row at200%/1366x768; tooltip Installed applications is visible.

name: 19-storage-ctrlend-200
note: Storage Ctrl+End reveals last selected Downloads row; Downloads checkup tooltip visible.

name: 20-apps-tab-grid-200
note: Tab from Apps search reveals first inventory row and visible focus rectangle at200%/1366x768.

name: 21-apps-ctrlend-suspected-clipped-focus
note: Ctrl+End reaches last Apps row, but rightmost focused cell is a narrow strip at viewport edge; value not readable. Suspected F020 focus-reveal failure, diagnostic confirmation pending.

name: 22-apps-end-still-clipped
note: End after Ctrl+End leaves rightmost focused cell unreadably narrow; no automatic horizontal reveal.

name: 23-apps-manual-horizontal-still-narrow
note: Manual parent horizontal scroll to right moves grid but rightmost selected cell remains narrow, with only U visible. Indicates column-width/readability issue rather than outer viewport alone.

name: 24-apps-ctrlend-repeat-clipping
note: Repeated Ctrl+Home then Ctrl+End reproduces narrow unreadable rightmost focused cell. Acceptance stopped; no further gates run.
